Subject: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks again for the time today — useful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can move into a technical deep dive: \

Summary from call:\
- Goal: pilot RAG for internal knowledge base (product docs + internal support tickets) to power an agent and an internal search assistant.
- Key success metrics: grounding precision >= 90% on top-1, answer usefulness (subjective) 4/5 in user testing, and average token cost below $0.003 for target QPS.
- Constraints: strict PII removal, SOC2-aligned evidence for data retention, and on-prem option for legal review.

Redwood recommended next steps (short-term):
1) Share baseline eval artifacts (we'll run a focused RAG eval against 500 queries).
2) Recommend candidate models + retrieval/reranker config.
3) Schedule 60-min tech deep-dive with your ML infra and search folks.

What we'll deliver by Wednesday (May 12):
- CSV with per-query grounding + ranking results (attached).
- Recommended prompt set v1 for agent and search (attached).
- Suggested retriever + reranker pairing and grounding metrics definitions.

Ask from you: please confirm who from your side should join the deep-dive (ML infra, search/product owner, legal if needed). Also confirm whether we should include any internal doc sources behind SSO or a sample export is fine for the pilot.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@acme.com>, Priya Desai <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap and next steps

Sam — great questions. Short answers first, then attachments and links below.

Reranker recommendation:\
- Default recommendation: a lightweight cross-encoder only for top-10 candidates (hybrid approach). Retriever (dense bi-encoder) for initial recall, then a small cross-encoder (e.g., distilled cross-encoder or a 3-4 layer finetuned model) for rerank of top-K. This balances precision and CPU cost because rerank is constrained to top-10.
- If your infra cannot support a cross-encoder at inference, we can configure a fast bi-encoder rerank (ANNOY/HNSW distance + learned linear re-weight) and tune retriever thresholds. Expect ~4-6% drop in top-1 grounding precision vs a cross-encoder on our benchmarks.

Grounding metric definition (what we'll include in CSV):
- Top-1 grounding precision: percentage of queries where the top-ranked answer contains a verifiable citation to a retrieved doc (binary per-query).
- Citation coverage: fraction of answer tokens attributable to retrieved passages (estimated via simple overlap heuristics).
- Hallucination flag: manual label used in sampling-based validation (we'll flag likely hallucinations for review).

Artifacts attached / links:\
- acme_rag_eval_results.csv (per-query: query, prompt variant, retriever_ids, top_k_docs, top1_grounding, grounding_confidence, notes)
- acme_prompt_set_v1.txt (prompt templates + 10-shot examples used for evaluation)
- Benchmarks folder (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeRAGBenchmarks
- Internal doc: reranker-guidelines and tuning notes: https://redwood-internal/docs/reranker-guidelines

Notes on model fit:\
- Candidate models: try Redwood-13B-quant (fast + low cost) for search assistant; try Redwood-30B-rt for agent use-case where higher reasoning is required. For the reranker distillation we used a finetuned 3-layer cross-encoder derived from Redwood-13B.
- Quality regression concerns: we ran a temporal split test and saw a 3% drop in grounding for older docs when using a heavier prompt that encouraged synthesis. We suggest preserving a conservative prompt for the search assistant and a more permissive prompt for the agent with explicit citation requirements.

Reproducibility: the CSV includes the prompt variant column. README in the Drive folder explains how to replay the eval locally.

Next steps:\
- We will upload the Drive folder and confirm Wed May 12 delivery (ETA by 6pm PT).
- Confirm deep-dive: Thu May 13 10:00-11:00 PT?

Best —
Marissa
